name: quest-hud
description: HP and MP bars for the weekly limit and the context window, and the skill, zone and tasks you are on, above the prompt. Works with any skills. On command, scores your setup from 1 to 10 and suggests what to add, or posts your open GitHub work and alerts on a ranked Quest Board through your own gh. No model calls, nothing added to the context.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: What the HUD draws: nothing, dim bars on the hint line under the prompt (terminal only), the band above the prompt, or the band and the Road pane opened at the start (placed from 144 columns; /quest-hud:pane opens it at any width).

bars.title: Bars
bars.description: HP and MP only, or also the 5-hour window and the session cost.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: Who the band's portrait shows, above the prompt: the wizard, Claude's mascot or GitHub's Octocat. The Road keeps its own cast.

flavor.title: Flavour line
flavor.description: One dim line above the quest on the band: a tip when this session calls for one, otherwise a word from the zone. Changes at each turn.

graphics.title: Graphics
graphics.description: How the Road's scene is drawn in a terminal: found out once a session (auto: images where the terminal shows them, text cells elsewhere), or always as text cells, or always as images.

zones.title: Zone overrides
zones.description: Extra skill-to-zone rules, comma-separated: name=zone (zones: watchtower, harbour, dungeon, arena, forge, map, camp, wilds).
